'''Radiation zone assault trooper armor''' was specialized [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]] designed by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nashiak Llalik]]. It was employed by the elite [[radiation zone assault trooper]]s of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
